    """Compare panels on either side of a constant vertical divider.

    Output the left panel's background color except where the corresponding
    cells in both panels are identical, which is marked 3.

    candidates = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    width = min(split, w - split - 1)
    left = [row[split - width:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:split + 1 + width] for row in grid]
    vals = [x for row in left for x in row]
    left_bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else left_bg for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Compare corresponding cells in the two regions split by a solid line.

    Matching cells are marked 3; non-matches take the dominant color of the
    second region. The separator is discarded.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the solid full-height or full-width divider.
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    if vertical and (not horizontal or w >= h):
        c = min(vertical, key=lambda x: abs(x - (w - 1) / 2))
        n = min(c, w - c - 1)
        a = [row[c-n:c] for row in grid]
        b = [row[c+1:c+1+n] for row in grid]
        vals = [v for row in b for v in row]
        bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
        return [[3 if a[r][j] == b[r][j] else bg for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    r = min(horizontal, key=lambda x: abs(x - (h - 1) / 2))
    n = min(r, h - r - 1)
    a, b = grid[r-n:r], grid[r+1:r+1+n]
    vals = [v for row in b for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
